title: FRIDAY ARMS AND CORE
subtitle: FRIDAY. ARMS, TRUNK AND A STEADY PAIR OF LEGS. INCLINE PUSH-UPS, STAIR PLANK, SIDE PLANK, SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE, CAT-COW, WALL CHEST OPENER. FINISH THE WEEK STRONG AND OPEN.

script.welcome: FRIDAY, GRIMES. ARMS AND CORE. LAST PARADE OF THE WORKING WEEK, SO NO COASTING INTO THE WEEKEND ON A WING AND A BISCUIT. SIXTEEN MINUTES. PRESS, HOLD, BALANCE, THEN WE UNKINK THAT DESK SPINE. ON YOUR FEET.
script.nextSet: AGAIN. SAME STANDARD, NOT A WHISKER LESS.
script.rest: REST. SHAKE IT OUT. DO NOT EVEN LOOK AT YOUR INBOX.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. MAKE IT THE BEST ONE. EYES ON YOU.
script.complete: DISMISSED. ARMS WORKED, TRUNK BRACED, BALANCE TESTED, BACK AND CHEST OPEN. THAT IS A WEEK IN THE BANK. ENJOY THE WEEKEND, BUT IF YOU FACEPLANT INTO A CHEESE BOARD I WILL HEAR ABOUT IT. WEIGH IN MONDAY.
script.pause: HOLD. GET YOUR BREATH. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UPS (5TH STAIR, TIMED)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE 5TH STAIR, SHOULDER-WIDTH. BODY ONE STRAIGHT PLANK FROM HEAD TO HEELS. LOWER THE CHEST TO THE STEP, ELBOWS ABOUT 45 DEGREES, PRESS BACK UP. SMOOTH REPS FOR 30 SECONDS; PAUSE AT THE TOP IF FORM SLIPS.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. FIFTH STEP, WHERE YOU BELONG FOR NOW. THREE ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH. BODY LIKE A PLANK, CHEST TO THE STEP, PRESS AWAY. FORM FIRST. NOBODY GETS A MEDAL FOR UGLY REPS.
exercises.speakDone: PUSH UPS DONE. ARMS EARNED THEIR KEEP. GOOD.

exercises.name: STAIR PLANK HOLD (3RD STEP)
exercises.cue: FOREARMS OR HANDS ON THE 3RD STAIR, FEET BACK, BODY STRAIGHT FROM HEAD TO HEELS. SQUEEZE GLUTES, BRACE THE BELLY, RIBS DOWN. NO SAGGING HIPS, NO BUM IN THE AIR. BREATHE THROUGH THE HOLD.
exercises.speakStart: STAIR PLANK. THIRD STEP. THREE HOLDS. TWELVE SECONDS EACH. SQUEEZE THE BUM, BRACE THE BELLY, BODY LIKE A BROOM HANDLE. AND BREATHE, MAN. TURNING PURPLE IS NOT A TECHNIQUE.
exercises.speakDone: PLANK DONE. CORE OF IRON. WELL, CAST IRON. GOOD.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK (KNEE-DOWN LEGAL)
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE, ELBOW UNDER SHOULDER. BOTTOM KNEE DOWN IF NEEDED. LIFT THE HIPS SO SHOULDER, HIP AND KNEE MAKE A STRAIGHT LINE. HOLD 5 SECONDS, LOWER SLOWLY, SWITCH SIDES.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANK. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. ELBOW UNDER SHOULDER, KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. HIPS UP, STRAIGHT LINE. FIVE SECONDS. EVEN A CIVIL SERVANT CAN MANAGE FIVE SECONDS.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. OBLIQUES ON NOTICE. GOOD.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE
exercises.cue: STAND TALL BESIDE A CHAIR OR WALL, FINGERTIPS ON IT IF NEEDED. SOFT KNEE ON THE STANDING LEG. HINGE AT THE HIP, CHEST FORWARD, FREE LEG REACHING BACK LIKE A SEESAW. GO ONLY AS FAR AS YOU STAY LEVEL, PAUSE, RETURN TALL. 5 PER LEG.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG HINGE. BALANCE WORK. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE EACH LEG. FINGERTIPS ON THE CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. HINGE FORWARD, BACK LEG REACHES, HIPS LEVEL. PAUSE. STAND TALL. WOBBLE ALL YOU LIKE, JUST DO NOT FALL OVER IN FRONT OF THE STAFF.
exercises.speakDone: BALANCE DONE. STEADIER THAN LAST WEEK. I NOTICED.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. INHALE: DROP THE BELLY, LIFT CHEST AND TAILBONE (COW). EXHALE: ROUND THE BACK UP TOWARD THE CEILING, CHIN TO CHEST (CAT). SLOW, WITH THE BREATH.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. ON ALL FOURS. TWO ROUNDS. EIGHT SLOW ONES. BREATHE IN, BELLY DOWN, CHEST UP. BREATHE OUT, ROUND THE BACK LIKE A CROSS OLD TOMCAT. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR FAVOURITE, SO SAVOUR IT.
exercises.speakRest: FIFTEEN. SIT BACK ON YOUR HEELS.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO THE WALL. FOREARM FLAT ON THE WALL, ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT. STEP THROUGH WITH THE NEAR FOOT AND TURN THE CHEST GENTLY AWAY UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER AND CHEST OPEN. SHOULDER DOWN, BREATHE. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL, STEP THROUGH, TURN AWAY. SHOULDER DOWN. A WHOLE WEEK OF HUNCHING OVER A KEYBOARD, AND WE ARE UNDOING IT RIGHT NOW.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN, SHOULDERS BACK. THAT IS THE WEEK. DISMISSED.
